My plan:
- Toxapex can stall out Garchomp with Toxic/Baneful Bunker/Haze/Recover. Since Toxapex is immune to Earthquake, this is a good matchup.

Gholdengo is weak to: Ghost, Dark, Fire, Ground, Psychic.

Garchomp's Dragon moves do nothing to Gholdengo (Dragon immunity).
